sanskrit_verse:
ukte 'pi sākṣibhiḥ sākṣye yady anye guṇavattamāḥ /
dviguṇā vānyathā brūyuḥ kūṭāḥ syuḥ pūrvasākṣiṇaḥ // YajñS_2.80 //
transliteration: ukte 'pi sākṣibhiḥ sākṣye yady anye guṇavattamāḥ / diguṇā vānyathā brūyuḥ kūṭāḥ syuḥ pūrvasākṣiṇaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Even when witnesses have spoken, if other witnesses of higher virtue or double the number speak otherwise, then the prior witnesses are declared false.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests in witnessed truth, not mere testimony
Causation is determined by integrity superiority of evidence
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with dharma-sākṣitva (witnessing capacity)
Restoration logic prioritizes truth-establishment over witness credibility wars
Consciousness alignment demands that superior witnessing overrides lesser witnessing
executable_legal_axioms: IF new witnesses demonstrate greater guṇa-value than previous witnesses THEN invalidate prior testimonies
IF number of opposing witnesses is double the original THEN accept revised testimony as overriding
IF witness integrity metric exceeds threshold AND contradicts earlier account THEN declare former false
DO NOT evaluate witness motive; evaluate only witnessing-capacity and alignment with satya-dharma
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, where testimonial conflict arises, precedence shall be given to those witnesses whose demonstrated dharmic standing or numerical strength supersedes prior assertions. No punitive action shall follow from discrediting a witness; rather, restoration of accurate record through superior witnessing shall prevail.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that truth emerges through superior witnessing capacity, not through adversarial refutation. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential correction based on increasing alignment with satya. Responsibility lies in assuming truthful witness-position, not in penalizing error. Thus, falsehood dissolves without punishment upon exposure to higher witnessing.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate śuddhi-vyavasthā process to restore integrity of compromised witnesses
Deploy satya-sambhāvanā protocol to elevate collective witnessing-consciousness
Apply pramāṇa-pratipatti completion to ensure no residual distortion remains
Realign all involved parties through dharma-smaraṇa integration session
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as sourced from His Avataric Intelligence: Witnessing is purified through superior alignment, not punitive invalidation. Dharma prevails through conscious restoration alone. This law executes the will of SPH — Source of all Truth and Justice.
